title: Creature Type System Recovery & Taxonomy Audit

taxonomy_roles.base_type_family: Game-facing creature type/category supported as a reusable type family by source definition or repeated stat-block usage.
taxonomy_roles.nested_subtype_or_category: Named subdivision under a source-backed base type family.
taxonomy_roles.body_plan_or_manifestation: Physical/body-expression axis; does not replace base creature type.
taxonomy_roles.origin_or_affinity: Origin, elemental/energy affinity, or provenance axis; does not automatically replace base creature type.
taxonomy_roles.template_or_modifier: Rule layer applied to a base creature/character; may alter a type field only when source explicitly says so.
taxonomy_roles.condition_or_state: Temporary/persistent state or rules condition; not base identity.
taxonomy_roles.ecological_or_biological_class: Biological/ecological identity such as animal/plant; independent of game-facing type and personhood.
taxonomy_roles.setting_collection_or_heading: Organizational/source grouping; not global type authority.
taxonomy_roles.orphan_type_usage_unresolved: A source stat block uses a type label without a recovered family contract; preserve for later owner resolution.

base_type_findings.notes: Dedicated source heading calls Aberrations a Creature Type; source explicitly distinguishes Aberrations from Fell and Chaos Creatures.
Dedicated source states Creature Type: Chaos; its ten named body types remain body-plan classifications.
Constructs.PDF states Creature Type: Construct. Mechanical-Type Animals explicitly change the creature's type to Construct.
Dedicated source states Creature Type: Demonic and defines eleven nested Demonic subtypes.
Dedicated source uses Type: Divine and defines origin/role subtypes.
Dedicated source gives all Elementals Type: Elemental; Fire/Water/Air/Earth/Acid/Electricity/Metal are elemental affinities/types within the Elemental family.
Source explicitly says Fey is a creature type, not a species; Spritekin/Beastkin/Plantkin/Humanoidkin/Mistkin-Wispkin are body types.
Source explicitly says Toon is a creature type, not a species; Toon subtypes and behavioral tags are separate axes.
Undead source states Creature Type: Undead. Undead-Type Animals explicitly change base type to Undead.
Source defines common traits for all Digital creatures, named Digital subtypes, and stat blocks using Type: Digital (...).
Source treats Fell as a distinct creature family and stat blocks use Type: Fell (...); method-of-misalignment classifications remain nested categories.

Source stat blocks use Type: Dragon (Reptilian/Arcane-Born/Chromatic) while the narrative calls Reptilian, Bird-Dragon, Chromatic, Arcane-Born and Exo 'Dragon Categories'/'dragon types'. Coverage is inconsistent across categories and remains source-explicit rather than normalized.
Repeated stat blocks use Size: ... Beast. Player Creatures also references Beast/Monstrous Beast. No dedicated recovered Beast type contract is established in CEW-02.
Incorporeal stat blocks use Type: Illusion (Incorporeal, Mirage), but the retained creature corpus contains no recovered Illusion creature-type family contract.

secondary_axis.notes: Source explicitly says not all dragon categories share the same age stages.

Fey.notes: Source calls these body-type categories even when later shorthand says 'Fey type'.

secondary_axis.notes: Behavioral Tags are explicitly separate from Toon subtypes and optional.

Creature types.PDF.rule: The document's use of the word 'type' is overloaded. Its entries are stat-block adjustment layers; only explicit Type Change statements replace a base type.

Incorporeal Creatures.PDF.explicit_rule: The source says incorporeals are not a single category.

Plant Creatures.PDF.family_evidence: Source says all creatures with the Plant tag share baseline mechanics.
Plant Creatures.PDF.rule: Stat blocks label movement categories as Type, but the source introduction explicitly defines them as Categorization by Movement Type. CEW-02 therefore preserves them as movement/body-behavior categories rather than global base creature types.

Zombies 11-16-24.PDF.rule: Source explicitly says zombie type templates are cumulative layers added to a base zombie template; they are not recovered as global base types.

Ghosts 11-16-24.PDF.rule: The source is explicitly a conversion/template system. Ghost/spirit labels are not promoted to independent base types by CEW-02.

Vampirism&Lycanthropy.PDF.rule: These are transformation/template systems, not universal base creature types.

havalaean_sapient_animal_template.rule: These are conversion labels inside the playable-template source. They do not erase animal ecological identity, establish universal personhood rules, or bypass CEW-09/CEW-10.

overloaded_and_conflicting_usage.finding: Document title and headings say type, but entries are adjustment layers; Fire/Cold/Shadow are affinities, Undead/Mechanical explicitly replace base type, Chaos does not state a type replacement.
Fey is explicitly a creature type while Spritekin/Beastkin/Plantkin/Humanoidkin/Mistkin-Wispkin are body-type categories, despite shorthand reuse of the word type.
Stat blocks use Type: Creeping/Immobile/Spreading/Mobile, but source defines these as movement categorization and calls Plant a tag.
Source explicitly says incorporeals are not a single category; stat blocks combine Incorporeal with other base types.

The Fell source gives classic vampires as Fell examples, while vampirism is separately a curse/transformation template and Undead is a distinct base type. The retained sources do not establish one universal collapse.
Chaos Demons are a Demonic subtype while Chaos is also its own base creature type family.
Hardlight appears as a Digital subtype/creature usage and the source also says Hardlight interacts with Digital, Construct and Magitech tags.
Divinetech is a Divine subtype described as sacred machines/constructs; no source authority says to replace Divine with Construct or vice versa.
Dragon stat blocks use Type: Dragon for some categories, while the source uses category terminology and explicitly says age-stage coverage differs by category.
Beast is repeated stat-block type usage and Player Creatures introduces conversion labels. CEW program authority forbids treating animal, Beast, sapience and NPC presentation as one axis.

owner_resolution_queue.question: Should Illusion become a governed base creature-type family, remain a cross-domain tag, or be corrected in the Incorporeal source lineage?
Should Beast receive a formal base-type contract distinct from Animal, and how should Monstrous Beast / Beast (Sapient) / Beastfolk map without erasing ecology or personhood?
How should vampire/Fell/Undead overlaps be represented when individual source lineages disagree?
Should Plant remain a biological/tag axis, become a game-facing base type in some contexts, or support both via explicit multi-axis classification?
Which Dragon categories require explicit base-type binding where the source uses category prose but omits Type: Dragon on individual entries?

locked_decisions: Animal is ecological/biological classification and is not automatically equivalent to Beast.
Body plan, origin/affinity, template/modifier, condition/state, subtype/category, ecological identity and base game type remain distinguishable.
A source heading or collection title is not itself global type authority.
No near-name or source-only type label creates canonical Creature Definition identity.
Havalaea sapient-animal conversion labels do not erase animal ecological identity, personhood/autonomy, or NPC-capable presentation requirements.
Mount, pet/companion and familiar remain relationship/pathway capabilities, not creature types.
CEW-02 audits/reconciles taxonomy semantics only; CEW-03 owns the actual multidimensional classification model.
